project_info.network_architecture: Cloud-based IoT architecture utilizing MQTT over TLS and CoAP protocols for device communication, with message routing through Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming. Devices connect through a communication gateway that performs protocol translation and message routing to backend services hosted on AWS.
key_components: Data Processing Engine (real-time analytics, anomaly detection)
